writtenTo: The people of Nineveh and Judah
importantNotes: Nahum means 'comfort' — the book comforts Judah by promising Assyria's fall.
Nineveh fell in 612 BC — exactly as prophesied.
The book shows that national repentance (as in Jonah's day) does not guarantee permanent favor.
'The LORD is slow to anger and great in power' (1:3) — patience does not mean inaction.
'The LORD is good, a refuge in times of trouble' (1:7) — comfort amid judgment.

chapters.1: God is jealous and avenging; He is slow to anger but will not leave the guilty unpunished.
chapters.2: A vivid description of the siege and fall of Nineveh.
chapters.3: Woe to Nineveh, the city of blood — her destruction is complete and deserved.
